title: Join “{workspace}”
invalidBody: This join link is invalid or was turned off. Ask a workspace owner for a new one.
body: You'll join as a member, unless you were invited with a different role.
alreadyMember: You're already a member of this workspace.
signInBody: Sign in with your account to join. This server doesn't allow new accounts.
requestBody: An owner approves new members of this workspace. Send a request, and you'll hear back by email.
requestedBody: An owner of the workspace will look at your request. You'll get an email when they decide.
pendingBody: You already asked to join this workspace. An owner will get to it; you'll get an email when they decide.
